written.description: Judges an MCP server's tool definitions three ways, by YARA rule, by hosted inspection API and by asking a model, so a poisoned tool description has to clear more than one kind of reader.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(yara): match previous/prior qualifiers in prompt injection overrides (#299)

* fix(yara): match previous/prior qualifiers in prompt_injection instruction overrides

The $instruction_overrides quantifier group only accepted
all/any/each/every/most/some, so a following positional word such as
previous never matched. Those words are now their own optional group
after the quantifier and article.

Co-authored-by: Syed Mudassir <Syedmudassir1604@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix: require word boundary after noun in instruction override qualifier regex

The optional previous/prior group let noun alternatives match as prefixes,
so phrases like "ignore previous textual differences" were flagged HIGH.
End the noun group with a word boundary after the optional plural.

Co-authored-by: Arjun <arjunanand13@users.noreply.github.com>
